mapper.sql: c.id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, c.code AS code, u.real_name AS teacherName, c.capacity AS maxStudents, IFNULL(sel.selectedCount, 0) AS selectedCount, c.credit AS credit, c.semester AS semester, (c.capacity - IFNULL(sel.selectedCount, 0)) AS remaining, (SELECT IFNULL(AVG(ce_inner.score), 0) FROM course_evaluation ce_inner WHERE ce_inner.course_id = c.id) AS avgScore

FROM course c INNER JOIN sys_user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS selectedCount FROM selection_record WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY course_id ) sel ON c.id = sel.course_id
WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.capacity > IFNULL(sel.selectedCount, 0) AND c.id NOT IN ( SELECT course_id FROM selection_record WHERE student_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 )
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.code, u.real_name, c.capacity, c.credit, c.semester
mapper.select:
SELECT c.id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, c.code AS code, u.real_name AS teacherName, c.capacity AS maxStudents, IFNULL(sel.selectedCount, 0) AS selectedCount, c.credit AS credit, c.semester AS semester, CAST(GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT CONCAT( '周', cs.day, ' 第', cs.lesson, '节', CASE WHEN cs.room IS NOT NULL AND cs.room != '' THEN CONCAT(' (', cs.room, ')') ELSE '' END ) ORDER BY cs.day, cs.lesson SEPARATOR '；' ) AS CHAR) AS scheduleTime, (c.capacity - IFNULL(sel.selectedCount, 0)) AS remaining,
(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM selection_record sr WHERE sr.course_id = c.id AND sr.student_id = #{userId} AND sr.status = 1 ) > 0 AS isSelected, NULL AS reason, (SELECT AVG(ce_inner.score) FROM course_evaluation ce_inner WHERE ce_inner.course_id = c.id) AS avgScore FROM course c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS selectedCount FROM selection_record WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY course_id ) sel ON c.id = sel.course_id LEFT JOIN course_schedule cs ON c.id = cs.course_id AND cs.status = 1
c.status = 1
AND ( c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.keyword}, '%') OR c.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.keyword}, '%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.keyword}, '%') )
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.code, u.real_name, c.capacity, c.credit, c.semester ORDER BY c.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FROM course c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id
c.status = 1
AND ( c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.keyword}, '%') OR c.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.keyword}, '%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.keyword}, '%') )

SELECT su.id AS studentId, su.username AS studentNo, su.real_name AS studentName, oc.grade_year AS grade, om.name AS majorName, sr.selected_time AS selectTime FROM selection_record sr LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON sr.student_id = su.id LEFT JOIN org_class oc ON su.class_id = oc.id LEFT JOIN org_major om ON su.major_id = om.id WHERE sr.course_id = #{courseId} AND sr.status = 1 ORDER BY sr.selected_time ASC

SELECT
HAVING avgScore >= 4.0 ORDER BY avgScore DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO selection_record(student_id, course_id, selected_time, status) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{courseId}, NOW(), 1)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM selection_record WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM selection_record WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.select: SELECT cs.id AS scheduleId, cs.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, cs.day AS `day`, cs.lesson AS lesson, cs.week AS weekJson, cs.room AS classroom FROM course_schedule cs INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = cs.course_id WHERE cs.course_id = #{courseId} AND cs.status = 1 AND c.status = 1

SELECT cs.id AS scheduleId, cs.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, cs.day AS `day`, cs.lesson AS lesson, cs.week AS weekJson, cs.room AS classroom FROM course_schedule cs INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = cs.course_id INNER JOIN selection_record sr ON sr.course_id = cs.course_id WHERE sr.student_id = #{studentId} AND sr.status = 1 AND cs.status = 1 AND c.status = 1

SELECT c.id AS courseId, c.code AS code, c.name AS courseName, u.real_name AS teacherName, c.credit AS credit, -- 汇总上课时间以及对应教师：周1 第2节；周3 第4节 GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT CONCAT('周', cs.day, ' 第', cs.lesson, '节-', cs.room) ORDER BY cs.day, cs.lesson SEPARATOR '；' ) AS scheduleTime, -- 周次 CAST(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT cs.week ORDER BY cs.day, cs.lesson SEPARATOR '；') AS CHAR) AS week, sr.id AS selectRecordId FROM selection_record sr INNER JOIN course c ON sr.course_id = c.id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id LEFT JOIN course_schedule cs ON c.id = cs.course_id AND cs.status = 1 WHERE sr.student_id = #{studentId} AND sr.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.code, c.name, u.real_name, c.credit, sr.id
